failure.title: Lint parsed immutable evidence as live source and exposed live-test style violations
failure.note: The retained summary records 85 errors: 14 project-service parse failures in immutable evidence plus strict callback, hook-global, return-type, and unnecessary-assertion findings in live tests.
failure.diagnosis: The global lint inputs did not exclude frozen pre-fix TypeScript snapshots, which are evidence rather than compilable source. Newly added live native and coach tests also violated existing strict style and hook-purity rules.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
